name: smartspend
description: SmartSpend - Personal Finance & Expense Tracker (Bug Hunting Edition)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });"

author: SmartSpend Team
